mentions.name: bookcall.io
mentions.description: This app is an all-in-one client call booking platform that replaces a stack of separate paid tools. It bundles integrated video calls, a landing page, custom domain support, and document attachments for people taking client bookings.
mentions.problem: The author was annoyed that clients booking a call required using and paying for a bunch of separate tools like Calendly, Zoom, and Linktree/website.
mentions.source_excerpt: I was annoyed with how clients can book a call with me, having to use and pay for a bunch of tools (like calendly, zoom, linktree/website etc.) so I built bookcall.io over the holidays. Launching soon with integrated video calls, a landing page, custom domain, attaching documents, and all that stuff, shipping this depending on demand.
